name: Fresh Start
description: Kick off the year with something light and bright — think clean citrus, delicate sponges, and nothing too heavy.

name: Sweetheart Showcase
description: Romance is in the air — build something worthy of a Valentine's centerpiece, blush tones and all.

name: Citrus Season
description: Lemon, orange, or anything else that bites back — this month is all about acidity and zest.

name: Spring Garden
description: Floral, pastel, and blooming — build a cake that looks like it grew in a garden.

name: Berry Bliss
description: Raspberry, strawberry, whatever's in season — let a berry filling or garnish lead the way.

name: Wedding-Worthy
description: June is wedding season — build something elegant enough to be a showstopper centerpiece.

name: Tropical Getaway
description: Coconut, pineapple, anything that tastes like vacation — beat the heat with a tropical build.

name: Retro Bake
description: Funfetti, classic vanilla, throwback combos — channel a cake straight out of a 1980s birthday party.

name: Cozy Spice
description: Cinnamon, carrot, warm spice — the first cool weeks of fall call for something cozy.

name: Rich & Decadent
description: Go dark, go rich, go all in on chocolate — this month has no room for restraint.

name: Comfort Classics
description: The flavors that feel like home — build the cake you'd want on a holiday dessert table.

name: Festive Showstopper
description: End the year with maximum decoration — gold leaf, sprinkles, drips, whatever makes it feel like a celebration.
